table.title: Three-level deep nested numbered list (sub-steps and options)

entry.codeblock: # Creating an Alarm Notification 1. Configure notification settings. 1. Define notification details. 1. Enter the notification name. 2. Select a notification type. 2. Configure delivery methods. 2. Save the notification.

Creating an Alarm Notification Configure notification settings. Define notification details.
  1. Enter the notification name.
  2. Select a notification type.
 Configure delivery methods. Save the notification.

section.p: Result: The converter maps the first nested level to DITA <substeps>. Because DITA tasks do not support nested substeps within substeps, the third level is converted into an ordered list contained within the associated substep information.

Warning :DITA task topics support only one level of <substeps>. Additional nested procedural levels may be converted to generic ordered lists or require restructuring. Avoid procedures deeper than two levels. If additional hierarchy is required, consider creating separate task topics.
